missions.objective: Preserve lease ownership. An active lease may only be released by its actor even with force_expired=True. Keep existing expiry cleanup, atomic CAS and activity recording.
missions.test:
import ast
from contextlib import nullcontext
from pathlib import Path
source = ast.parse(Path('/work/program.py').read_text())
lease = {'lease_id': 'lease-demo', 'actor': 'antigravity-ide', 'expires_at': 20}
class LeaseConflict(RuntimeError): pass
class Store:
    def __init__(self, _): pass
    def put_cas(self, key, value, previous):
        writes.append(value['leases'])
        return True
writes = []
ns = dict(Path=Path, _validate_actor=str, _coord_dir=Path, _lease_transaction=lambda _: nullcontext(), _read_raw_leases=lambda _: ([lease], {'leases': [lease]}), _split_leases=lambda raw, ts: ([r for r in raw if r['expires_at'] > ts], sum(r['expires_at'] <= ts for r in raw)), FileStore=Store, LEASES_KEY='leases', LeaseConflict=LeaseConflict, _append_activity_locked=lambda *_: None, _utc_iso=str)
node = next(n for n in source.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'release_lease')
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), '<function>', 'exec'), ns)
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
with TemporaryDirectory(dir='/scratch') as tmp:
    (Path(tmp) / 'ledger').mkdir()
    release = ns['release_lease']
    try:
        release(tmp, 'lease-demo', actor='codex-cli', force_expired=True, now=10)
    except LeaseConflict:
        pass
    else:
        assert False  # case: foreign-active-lease
    assert writes == []
    assert release(tmp, 'lease-demo', actor='antigravity-ide', now=10)['released']
    assert release(tmp, 'lease-demo', actor='codex-cli', force_expired=True, now=30)['expired_purged'] == 1

missions.objective: When checking paths claimed by active controllers on the same base branch, fold path case on Windows (sys.platform == 'win32') only. Preserve case-sensitive comparisons on POSIX, active lease checks, and isolation by branch. Change only this function.
missions.test:
import ast, sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
source = ast.parse(Path('/work/program.py').read_text())
node = next(n for n in source.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'detect_campaign_collisions')
class Store:
    def __init__(self, root): self.issue = int(root.parent.name.split('-')[1])
    def keys(self, prefix): return ['approval']
    def get(self, key):
        return {'mission': {'id': 'case', 'path': {300: 'scripts/Example.py', 301: 'scripts/example.py'}[self.issue]}} if key == 'approval' else None
for name in ['scripts', 'scripts.agents', 'scripts.agents.protocol', 'scripts.agents.protocol.store']:
    sys.modules[name] = ModuleType(name)
sys.modules['scripts.agents.protocol.store'].FileStore = Store
ns = dict(Path=Path, sys=SimpleNamespace(platform='win32'), ide_coordination=SimpleNamespace(check_conflicts=lambda *a, **kw: []))
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node], type_ignores=[]), '<function>', 'exec'), ns)
with TemporaryDirectory(dir='/scratch') as tmp:
    for issue in (300, 301): (Path(tmp) / f'campaign-{issue}' / 'ledger').mkdir(parents=True)
    specs = [dict(issue=issue, base_ref='agents/test') for issue in (300, 301)]
    assert set(ns['detect_campaign_collisions'](specs, tmp)) == {301}  # case: windows-alias
    ns['sys'].platform = 'linux'
    assert ns['detect_campaign_collisions'](specs, tmp) == {}
